svg.title: Illustrative UI test of the AI Foundry Lab with mocked APIs
svg.desc: An animated tour of three illustrative screenshots from the Lab's browser tests, which use mocked APIs, so nothing was published, sent, or saved. 1, the Create agent page with nine template cards showing each job's model and tools. 2, a new Chat with the default agent's guide and example tasks. 3, a Document review with a gap, a supported item, and its quoted source.
svg.text: AI Foundry Lab · illustrative UI test with mocked APIs
